issue: Independent nominal-millisecond rounding was an ambiguous slow/fast join identity when causal native loop-sequence identity was available.
clarification: Join on exact (PRN, native loop_sequence) from the identical handoff, validate the paired raw starts, assign the pair to the rounded mean raw-IQ millisecond, and retain one causal update per PRN/millisecond.
frozen_effect: Alignment only; loop bandwidths, features, validity gates, model, thresholds, block pooling, alarm rule, and GO criteria are unchanged.

carrier_phase_clarification.rule: Use the already-continuous native accumulator directly; do not apply modulo-phase np.unwrap a second time.
carrier_phase_clarification.reason: A second unwrap aliases legitimate carrier advance greater than pi per code epoch.

epoch_reducer_implementation_repair.reason: The first implementation used an O(number_of_epochs * number_of_rows) Boolean mask loop and was terminated before producing thresholds.
epoch_reducer_implementation_repair.repair: Exactly equivalent one-PRN-per-epoch median pooling using lexicographic grouping and a bounded-width padded matrix.
